differences.a_observable: The camera is positioned closer to the blocks, resulting in a tighter composition where the yellow and blue blocks occupy more screen space.
differences.b_observable: The camera is positioned further away, making the blocks appear smaller with more visible background tiles.
differences.fix: Bring the camera closer or adjust the focal length to match the framing.

differences.a_observable: Stronger contrast with deeper shadows under the blocks and a clear light falloff towards the edges.
differences.b_observable: Flatter, more uniform lighting across the tiles with very weak shadows under the blocks.
differences.fix: Adjust the light sources to increase contrast and add a subtle vignette or falloff to match Video A.

differences.a_observable: The yellow Recurly card has a glossy finish with visible specular highlights and reflections.
differences.b_observable: The yellow Recurly card has a flat, matte finish with no specular highlights.
differences.fix: Increase the specularity and roughness settings of the yellow card material to match the glossy look of Video A.

json.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera framing and increase the lighting contrast to match the tighter, more dramatic look of Video A.
